name: schema-studio
description: Schema Studio for Ubuntu: compare, version and deploy database schemas on your own computer.

scripts.build:ts: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.contract.json
scripts.build: npm run build:ts && npm run build:config && npm run build:server && npm run fetch:postgres
scripts.start: npm run build:ts && npm run build:config && electron .
scripts.dist:deb: npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.cjs --linux deb
